context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 漏洩/細菌/噴火/波及/苦戦/スキャンダル/万一/同調

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、情報漏洩問題、現代社会の課題ですね。
lines.en: Sakura, the information leak issue—that's a real challenge of our time, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Calm authority. Sets intellectual tone without distance. Genuine curiosity in her delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。細菌絡みの食中毒、別章で扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. The bacterial contamination and food poisoning—we covered that in a separate section.
lines.style: Focused, engaged response. Direct eye contact level. Showing she's thought through the structure. Slight pride in her organization.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 噴火災害の歴史、調査、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Your research on volcanic disasters and their history—that was really meticulous.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the voice. Leans slightly forward. Emphasizes 'meticulous' with quiet respect. Not flattery—observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 地域経済への波及、データで示しました。
lines.en: I traced the ripple effects through the local economy and showed it with data.
lines.style: Controlled confidence. Matter-of-fact about her methodology. Not defensive—factual. Slight lift on 'data' to show she trusts her work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被災者が苦戦している現状、章末で扱いましたね。
lines.en: And you addressed the real struggles the disaster victims are facing at the end of that section.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment. Recognizes the human weight she added. Reflective pace. Not rushing past the gravity of the subject.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: スキャンダル報道との比較、興味深い視点です。
lines.en: Comparing that to scandal coverage in the media—that was a really interesting angle.
lines.style: Bright, genuine interest. Slight lean-in tone. Sees the sophistication of the connection. Encouragement without overselling.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 万一の備え、地域でどう連携するか、論じましたか。
lines.en: So when it comes to emergency preparedness—how communities can actually coordinate when disaster strikes—did you touch on that?
lines.style: Probing but not testing. Gentle Socratic edge. Curious where she's going with this. Warm enough that it feels like genuine interest, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。世論に同調しがちな政治、批判的に扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I looked critically at how political responses tend to follow public opinion rather than lead it.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful conclusion. Conviction without aggression. Mature take delivered without hesitation. Slight pause before speaking shows she's considered it carefully.
